verdict.rationale: LangGraph's own README and docs present tracing through LangSmith as a LangGraph feature: visualization tools that trace execution paths, capture state transitions and give runtime metrics, plus a tracing quickstart for following data through each step. The UI, however, is the separate LangSmith product, and the evidence never says each individual LLM call and tool invocation is captured. missing for 10: explicit evidence that every LLM call and tool invocation is traced, first-party tracing setup/UI detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: Debugging with LangSmith — Gain deep visibility into complex agent behavior with visualization tools that trace execution paths, capture state transitions, and provide detailed runtime metrics.
Trace and compare these workflow patterns with LangSmith... Follow the tracing quickstart to see how data flows through each step.
